description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of tasks (# tasks) associated with various language families, with the categories listed along the vertical axis and their corresponding task counts represented by the length of horizontal bars along the horizontal axis, which is labeled “# tasks” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80. The bars are sorted in descending order from top to bottom, starting with “IE-Slavic” at the top and ending with “Basque” at the bottom. Each bar is colored differently and labeled with its respective language family: “IE-Slavic” is a dark gray bar extending to approximately 79; “IE-Romance” is a dark blue bar extending to approximately 47; “IE-Germanic” is a light green bar extending to approximately 44; “Uralic” is a medium green bar extending to approximately 20; “IE-Baltic” is a reddish-brown bar extending to approximately 17; “IE-other” is a maroon bar extending to approximately 15; “IE-Indic” is a tan bar extending to approximately 10; “Semitic” is an orange-brown bar extending to approximately 9; “Turkic” is a light gray bar extending to approximately 5; and “Basque” is a dark purple bar extending to approximately 4. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color and length.
